ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT, made as of this I' day of June, 2008 (this “Agreement"), is between 625 FULTON ASSOCIATES, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at Forest City Ratner Companies, LLC, One MetroTech Center North, 11th Floor, Brooklyn, New York 11201 (herein called “Office Owner"), and FC Forest City Ratner Companies, LLC, One MetroTech Center North, 11" Floor, Brooklyn, New York 11201 (herein called“Residential Owner"). RECITALS: A.Office Owner is the owner of the land described in Exhibit A hereto, which land is designated as Tax Lot 1 in Block 2094 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County (the "Tax Map"), and known by the street address of 625 Fulton Street, Brooklyn, New York (which land is herein called “Office Owner's Land"), together with the improvements now orhereafter located on Office Owner's Land (herein called“Office Owner's Improvements"; and the Office Owner's Land and the Office Owner's Improvements are herein collectively called "Office Owner's Property"). B. The Office Owner's Land consists of a 63,053 square foot parcel, with 630,530 square feet of Development Rights being associated with the Office Owner's Land as of the date hereof (without giving effect to the Declaration referred to below).As currently constructed, the Office Owner's Improvements utilize 329,850 square feet of Development Rights, leaving 300,680 square feet of unutilized Development Rights as of the date hereof (without giving effect to the Declaration referred to below). C. Residential Owner is the owner of the land described in Exhibit B hereto, which land is designated as Tax Lot 10 in Block 2094 on the Tax Map, and known by the street addresses of 80DeKalbAvenue,Brooklyn,NewYork(which land is herein called“Residential Owner's Land"), together with the improvements now or hereafter located on Residential Owner's Land (herein called“Residential Owner's Improvements";and the Residential Owner's Land and Residential Owner's Improvements are herein collectively called “Residential Owner's Property"). D. The Residential Owner's Land consists of a 13,630 square foot parcel, with as of the date hereof (without giving effect to the Declaration referred to below).
